rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early-stage mass in all four views, with a dominant U-like bar enclosing a central void and a clear upper hierarchy. It is not merely a bounding-box fill; the carved/open center and lifted edge give it neighborhood-program plausibility. The main weakness is the silhouette: the form becomes somewhat stair- or notch-like in multiple views, which is acceptable only to the extent that the void and overhang remain legible. The blue frontage edge is answered by a visible ground response and threshold opening rather than a sealed wall, so the access relation is coherent. Overall it supports the neighborhood-living brief reasonably well, though it could be cleaner in its anchoring and less repetitive in the stepped section.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more pavilion-like and sculptural; candidate should not over-copy the curved roof language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise composition with a central void and a legible bridge/connector can support a neighborhood program while keeping the ground edge porous.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The reference is much larger and more distributed; the candidate must remain a compact street building, not a campus.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Campus-like clustering around a shared court demonstrates how multiple masses can preserve a public center and readable hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Do not imitate the facade regularity; only the void-and-overhang relation is relevant.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A shallow recess or carved ground void with an upper overhang creates an active public threshold at the street edge.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is more compact and blocky; avoid turning it into a long bar unless the plan can support it.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: An elongated mass with a central atrium and a folded roof can combine compactness with a clear internal public room.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is spread out and landscape-heavy; transfer the sectional/terrace logic, not the campus scale.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced low-rise wings and bridging elements can create a coherent neighborhood massing language with active open space and sectional variation.

warnings: No parcel-boundary hard-gate issue is visible; containment appears coherent.

Keep the dominant U-shaped gesture; avoid fragmenting the form into more pieces.
